title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Professional v9.12 -> Cool Edit Pro v.20 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy show highlighted by a blazing Scarlet Fire and tight Shakedown groove.
ai_review.review: The recording is a very clean SBD with careful patching of the few cuts, delivering crystal‑clear detail that lets the band's performance shine. The concert bursts into life within a minute of "Shakedown", stays energetic through "Day Job", and reaches a near‑perfect climax in the closing segment of "Scarlet Fire". Reviewers especially praise Brent’s keyboards and the overall precision and beauty of the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers give high marks (5 and 4 stars), praising the show’s energy, standout songs and excellent soundboard quality; the weighted average yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very nice SBD with clear, crisp mix; patches of a few cuts are praised as expertly done, no noticeable drop‑outs or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Groove locks in within the first minute of "Shakedown" and maintains momentum; second set peaks with an especially precise and beautiful closing segment of "Scarlet Fire".

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent is highlighted as a great keyboardist, adding fun and energy to the performance.
